S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  CRMA No.656 of 2019 (Bail Application)
 In  CRLA No.131 of 2019

Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Ram Singh Sammal, learned counsel for the appellant/ applicant.
Mr. V.K. Gemini, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State.

The appellant is husband of the deceased, who has been convicted for the offences under Sections 498A, 304B of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, whereby he has been sentenced to undergo 2 years, 10 years and 2 years of rigorous imprisonment for the respective offences.

Learned counsel for the applicant presses the bail application, on the ground, that the applicant is languishing in jail ever since 12.10.2017, because he was not released on bail during the course of trial and had continued so in custody till the delivery of judgment on 05.02.2009 and even, as on date, he is languishing in jail.
Since he has already completed 6 years out of the total sentence of 10 years, he may be considered to be released on bail.

Having considered the fact, that the applicant has served more than 6 years of the total sentence,
which has been imposed upon him, the applicant is directed to be released on bail, subject to furnishing of his personal bond and two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Sessions Court concerned.
However, depositing 50% of the penalty amount, as imposed under Section 304B of the IPC, will be the condition precedent for his release on bail.

(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 18.10.2023 Sukhbant CRLA/131/2019 on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166912929/
